summary: B6 probe and verify: DONE and run in full twice on the final phase-1 tree (BI's last code edit 12:51; final run 13:06). (1) PlayerProbe.cs replaces the stub and implements contract 18.2 on top of BI's v1.4 DemoScenario (6 checkpoints read from CheckpointNames/CheckpointTicks, CreateSession(out Monitor, BiomeId) when -biome is given). It is active only with -probe, in a windowed player, and refuses to start together with -devshot. It hooks Application.logMessageReceivedThreaded from RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod(SubsystemRegistration), so errors raised in the other subsystems' Awake are counted too. GameDirector applies -fps and Sfx applies -mute; the probe checks both. The demo session runs at TickRate 60 whatever -fps is, with AwaitingStart false. The probe never steers: frame code only reads. The screenshot discipline is the same as DevShot's: first rendered frame with Tick >= checkpoint, ScreenCapture, runner paused during the file wait (5 s max) plus 0.2 s. The state hash is read in a BeforeTick handler at exactly DemoScenario.EndTick (866), so it does not depend on the display rate. Shots: menu, thread, fill, cut, saved, pocket, caught, results. Each check logs one '[Probe] CHECK <name> PASS|FAIL' line. Checks: an analyzer self-test (a flat magenta frame must fail, a varied frame must pass, a coral frame is all paint and a navy frame has none), so the checks cannot pass vacuously. Every shader in Resources/Shaders loads, isSupported, has _PIO_ShaderId and is not an error shader; Shader Graph shaders must not run a 1-pass FallbackError (the player compiles 3 passes per URP graph). The current biome's own Composite/Bead/Overlay are required, because BiomeTheme silently falls back to the liquid shaders. Other checks: the OFL font loaded (not the LegacyRuntime fallback); -biome applied to BiomeTheme.Current; no enabled renderer without a material or with an unsupported or error shader, and visible uGUI texts non-empty, both checked at every shot; the _PIO_ActorField RT created; a renderer draws the biome composite. Scenario checks: the first non-flicker return is an unchased capture that grew the area; a chased return was saved with empty Cells and no area gain; a LassoPocket happened; the human was eliminated by the Spark after the pocket; EventCapHits is 0; and DemoScenario.Monitor.Evaluate passes. Pixel checks on every PNG: magenta <= 0.2 % and single exact color <= 98 %. A B6 paint guard adds that shots framing the human's puddle must show >= 0.3 % pixels of its biome color (6 to 22 % measured). The run ends with zero error or exception log entries. Output: [ProbeHash] after the demo, then the 20 s bot round (the human is a Balanced BotController, lasso on, fixed seed) with [ProbePerf] avgMs/p95Ms/tier, then [ProbeResult] PASS|FAIL <reasons> and Application.Quit(0|1). (2) tools/verify.ps1 keeps A1's dotnet/editmode steps and adds setup (SetupAndCompile: exit 0, no error CS, '[Builder] SetupAndCompile PASS'), playmode (JUnit, 0 tests refused), buildwindows (Build/Windows; freshness checked on PainterIO_Data since the exe keeps the engine's date), probe (liquid at -fps 30 and -fps 144: both PASS, equal hashes, no Exception / Crash / '[PainterIO] ... failed' line in the player logs, exit codes, timeout kill), probe-fire and probe-electric (-fps 60: PASS, screenshots, same hash as liquid since the Core is identical in every biome) and android with -Android, always last (BuildAndroid with -buildTarget Android, a fresh APK, android.permission.VIBRATE read back from the APK's binary manifest in UTF-16 and UTF-8). Options: -ProbeExe, -ProbeTimeoutSeconds, -MinPlayModeTests; the summary goes to docs/verify_last.txt. (3) tools/run.cmd starts Build/Windows/PainterIO.exe in a 540x960 window and passes extra arguments through (for example -biome fire); checked by launching a probe through it (PASS). (4) docs/playtest_7_7.md is the 18.5 device playtest template: 3 rounds lasso off then 3 on, the (a)/(b)/(c) observer checklist after the first cut, the v1.4 'loop lost' understanding, optional biome rounds, device checks and a verdict table that starts at PENDING_HUMAN. FINAL FULL RUN (docs/verify_last.txt, 13:06): PASS dotnet total=318 passed=316 (2 skipped by design); PASS setup (ShaderCheck 6 shaders, 0 failures); PASS editmode tests=414 failures=0 skipped=2; PASS playmode tests=8 failures=0, including BI's BootTests.Biome_SessionBiomeAppliesAndViewsRebindLive and the v1.4 Results_DemoRound test; PASS buildwindows 93.4 MB; PASS probe with liquid fps30 and fps144 both PASS, 8 shots each and equal hash 246577239DE179C4, perf avg 33.41 / 7.01 ms (frame capped) on tier High; FAIL probe-fire and FAIL probe-electric, ONLY because the phase-2 shaders FireComposite/FireBead/FireOverlay and ElectricComposite/ElectricBead/ElectricOverlay do not exist yet (every other check in those runs passes, no exception, hash equal to liquid); PASS android APK 32.2 MB with VIBRATE, build target restored to StandaloneWindows64. Run 1 (12:51) gave identical results. I looked at every screenshot of the final liquid run and at the biome menus and key shots. Liquid shows the menu with the three biome cards, the thread with a concave neck, the clean-capture fill with '+0,6 %', the cut with the droplet chain, front and tutorial pointer, the saved return with the evaporating beads and the toast 'Rentré 0,3 s avant l'étincelle : boucle perdue.', the striped pocket over the teal puddle, the catch splash, and results '4e'. In fire and electric, the theme palette, ground and HUD accent apply and the liquid shader fallback draws the shapes. 16 probe player runs in total, all exited cleanly with 0 or 1: B2's rare quit crash was not seen.

contract_issues: 18.2 step 4 says the probe prints [ProbeHash] and [ProbeResult] and then quits, while step 5 runs the 20 s bot round 'then' to catch runtime exceptions. Reading applied: [ProbeHash] is printed after the demo, then the bot round runs and prints [ProbePerf], and [ProbeResult] comes last with the exit code, so that exceptions raised during the bot round also fail the run.

18.2 names the shots thread/cut/fill/pocket/results.png. With the v1.4 DemoScenario (24.1) the probe saves menu, thread, fill, cut, saved (new SavedReturn checkpoint), pocket, caught and results.png. Any checkpoint BI adds later is captured automatically under its lower-cased name.

18.4 lists only the liquid probe at -fps 30 / 144. Per the wave B-2 task and 25.1, verify adds probe-fire and probe-electric at -fps 60. Each must PASS the full probe, and its [ProbeHash] must equal the liquid hash: the Core is identical in every biome, so a biome that changed the simulation is caught.

B6 checks stricter than 18.2, kept on purpose against false greens. (a) The current biome's own three shaders are required: BiomeTheme falls back to the liquid shaders with only an info log, so a stripped or unsupported biome shader would otherwise pass. (b) A Shader Graph shader running a 1-pass FallbackError fails (the player compiles 3 passes per URP Unlit graph, against 6 in the editor). (c) 'font not null' also fails on the LegacyRuntime.ttf fallback (UiKit.UsingFallbackFont). (d) The paint guard: plain ground with grain plus the HUD passes both 18.2 pixel rules, so shots that frame the human's puddle need >= 0.3 % of its biome color.

18.2 lists -fps and -mute as probe options. They are applied by GameDirector (11.1 frame settings) and by Sfx (16 hard mute); the probe only verifies them (targetFrameRate == n and vSync 0; Sfx.Instance.HardMuted).
